name: BSP_MenuInterface_ServicePendingRequests
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_on_move_map, read-only analysis. __fastcall(bool *out). For each of DAT_00e198ac and DAT_00e198b4, when the object's +0x3C flag is set it compares two index pairs ([1] vs [8] and [7] vs [0xE]), calls vtable+0x10 with the two target indices to service the difference, and writes 1 through the out pointer. Sole caller BSP_Game_OnMove at 004e5442 and again at 004e5477 inside the drain loop the decompiler removed as unreachable (004e5455-004e5488).

name: BSP_LogoSequence_AdvanceOrFinish
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frontend_states, read-only analysis. __thiscall, ECX = the logo object at 00E198A4, RET 0. Two callers: BSP_LogoSequence_PollSkip 006851c7 (tail jump) and BSP_LogoSequence_LoadTable 00685300. count = (this+48h - this+44h) / 8 over an 8-byte-element vector; index = this+60h. When index >= count it calls this->vtable[0] with 1 (a deleting form, the argument is pushed) and then BSP_Game_OnInitOnce(game, 0), which re-runs GGame::OnInitTitle and writes game+5D4h = 2. That is the state 1 to state 2 transition, a direct state write rather than a queued request. Otherwise it increments the index and registers the callback 00685060 on 00E18D48 through 004f8970 for the next logo.

name: BSP_LogoSequence_PollSkip
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frontend_states, read-only analysis. __thiscall, ECX = the 0x80 logo object at 00E198A4, no stack arguments, RET 0. Sole caller GGame::OnMove 004e4bee under game state 1. Body: clock 01090AB0 virtual +20h fills a 16-byte timestamp from this+68h, BSP_Timestamp_Subtract 00530890 returns it, elapsed = fild[eax] / fild[eax+8]; if elapsed > this+78h (float) and the edge-triggered input query 004d92b0(game, 0x4A) is true, tail jump to 00685070. Both conditions are required, so this is only the skip poll; the automatic advance is not in this body. The logo table comes from Scripts/datatables/Logos.lua via 00685300 (fields delay, (platform), (region), Szplessek).

name: BSP_LogoSequence_Construct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall, ECX = an 80h allocation, returns it in EAX. Chains base constructor 00684e10, stores vptr 00cf76e4 and zeroes the members at +44h..+6Ch. BSP_Game_BeginStartupSequence builds it into 00e198a4 at 004e57e5 on exactly the branch that leaves game+5D4h at 1, that is when neither skipLogos nor .scn was given, and then calls its virtual +4h. The logo role is inferred from that branch and from the skipLogos flag at 00e188ac, not from a string. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_GAME_ENTRY.md.

name: BSP_LogoSequence_LoadTable
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frontend_states, read-only analysis. __thiscall, ECX = the logo object at 00E198A4, RET unverified (large SEH body, not fully read). Loads Scripts/datatables/Logos.lua and reads the fields delay, (platform), (region) and Szplessek, filling the 8-byte-element vector at this+44h..+48h that BSP_LogoSequence_AdvanceOrFinish walks. The per-logo duration this+78h that BSP_LogoSequence_PollSkip compares against comes from the delay field. No callers are recorded in the index, so the entry point into the logo sequence is not established.

name: BSP_Game_UpdateBlockingScreen
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_on_move_map, read-only analysis. Provisional. Sole caller BSP_Game_OnMove at 004e4b3b with the raw frame delta, guarded by DAT_00e198bc != 0. When that object's +0x3C flag is set afterwards the frame runs BSP_GuiManager_Update, BSP_Game_Render and BSP_Game_FinishRenderFrame and returns at 004e4b8c, skipping the entire simulation: the loading/modal screen frame. name: BSP_TitleScreen_Construct

name: BSP_TitleScreen_Update

name: BSP_TitleScreen_Skip
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frontend_states, read-only analysis. __cdecl(void), RET 0. Called by GGame::OnInitTitle 004c9a70 in place of the title virtual +4h when skipTitle is set (docs/APP_INIT_GAME_ENTRY.md). Body: 00BD3450 on 0109CECC, then if game+5E8h (queued request count) is zero, BSP_Game_RequestState(4) and game+5ECh = 0. This is one of the two transitions from state 2 to state 4.

name: BSP_TitleScreen_Advance
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frontend_states, read-only analysis. __thiscall, ECX = the title object at 00E198C8, RET 0, SEH frame. Slot +4h of the title vtable 00CF7A98, the virtual GGame::OnInitTitle invokes. When 00E198CC is set it repeats BSP_TitleScreen_Skip's tail (00BD3450 on 0109CECC, then BSP_Game_RequestState(4) and game+5ECh = 0 if nothing is queued); otherwise it allocates a 0x18 byte object and builds the title presentation instead. This is the normal state 2 to state 4 transition.
